protocol.variant_description: reproduces the RESULTS.md 2026-08-03 baseline numbers: full recording, _latency-50 columns kept. NOT RCAEval's protocol; kept only to reconcile that record.
protocol.scoring: coarse-grained service ranking, column.split('_')[0].replace('-db', ''), first occurrence kept
protocol.note: nsigma and BARO receive the labeled injection time (inject_time.txt) and compare the 600 s before it with the 600 s after it. Faultline receives no injection time and must detect the onset itself.
